title: Yellow Glazed Slovakian Kabanos Skillet
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish featuring Polish kabanos sausage in a sweet and tangy yellow glaze, perfect for a sick day, and dairy-free-friendly. This dish is easy to make and can be ready in under an hour.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced kabanos sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the yellow glaze mix and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
